scope: H-55/H-65/H-66/H-71 growth, fading and useful recurrence, evaluated with H-76 input branches and H-77 cancellation; H-78 state choice remains open
assumptions: An idealized ring of L reference cohorts, each carrying the same semantic distribution, has positive scalar transition gains g_j. These are effective response gains, not assigned edge weights or anatomical positions.
No saturation, recurrent interference, stochastic input, controller, quantization or other state. The examples evaluate products of gains, not a trained SNN.

cycle_derivation.operator: W sends cohort j to j+1 modulo L with gain g_j.
cycle_derivation.full_lap: W^L = G*I, where G=product(g_j). Hence x[k+L]=G*x[k] for every initial phase mixture.
cycle_derivation.spectral_radius: rho(W)=G^(1/L). Positive body gain can produce finite transient growth even when 0<G<1.
cycle_derivation.similarity: With r=G^(1/L), h_0=1 and h_(j+1)=g_j*h_j/r, W=r*diag(h)*P*diag(h)^(-1), where P is the cyclic shift. An initial state proportional to h simply scales by r each step.
cycle_derivation.entry_dependence: A state concentrated at phase j has amplitude multiplied by the next k gains. A mixture sums those phase responses. Net lap attenuation alone does not specify the first peak or a smooth response from every entry.
cycle_derivation.universal_growth_limit: Every nonnegative phase input grows in total amplitude in one step only if every g_j>1, which forces G>1. This conditional linear ring cannot guarantee immediate growth from all phases while attenuating each lap.

illustrative_parameters.warning: Arbitrary arithmetic values, not model parameter recommendations.

noise_and_residual.balanced_noise_then_cancellation: For preexisting signed coordinate v and additive nonnegative noise with equal expected totals on the two polarities, H-77 gives v_next=v+noise_positive_total-noise_negative_total exactly. Thus E[v_next]=v. Cancellation alone cannot turn balanced background into an increased mean signed residual.
noise_and_residual.absolute_activity: The post-cancellation summed active rate is |v_next|. Its expectation can rise while the expected signed coordinate is unchanged; total activity recovery does not establish semantic amplification.
noise_and_residual.independent_cell_noise: With n cells per polarity and independent noise of per-cell variance s2, Var(v_next)=2*n*s2. Temporal whiteness alone does not imply this spatial independence.
noise_and_residual.common_noise_countercase: If all cells in both equal-sized polarity populations receive the same nonnegative draw and no other activity exists, the added activity cancels completely. A common CC-wide amplitude control is different from using one common random draw.
noise_and_residual.linear_shared_network: For fixed x_next=W*x+eta with state-independent identical additive drive in two coupled runs, their difference evolves as delta_next=W*delta. Increasing additive noise does not amplify that history difference. State-dependent noise regulation, nonlinear transfer and cancellation of population patterns break this reference assumption.
noise_and_residual.business_consequence: Desired weak-residual growth must be assessed in the learned recurrent/transfer response under its actual noise control. No extra fatigue, timer, routing, noise provenance or memory subsystem follows from this analysis.

interpretation: The H-76 focused and broad entry branches can excite different reference phase mixtures. Training acceptance must include actual entries rather than only a hand-chosen chain head.
Repeated subpeaks are compatible with a declining same-phase envelope; the loose half-life does not demand monotonic decrease on every frame.
Body/return smoothing and shared small loops must be assessed by the actual semantic response and later influence. Exact reference-cohort tracking is not a runtime requirement.
generation_learning_boundary: H-84: generation input calibration and evaluation of ensuing recurrence do not make the explicit broad weak fallback a teaching pattern or ordinary synaptic propagation to be learned. These conditional arithmetic results do not select flow learning targets.
